uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Attacking Pokémon from the opposing team copies their battle item for 30s. Defeating a wild Pokémon instead copies a random battle item for 30s. The copied item temporarily functions as the user’s battle item, without replacing or affecting the user’s original item. Once an item is copied, this ability will go on cooldown for 30s. Moving towards Aeos energy or gold coins increases the user's movement speed by 20%. Picking up gold coins increases the user's movement speed for 3s by 40% decaying by 5% every 0.5s to a minimum of 20%, and speeds up the rate at which Pickup's cooldown goes down by 13.5% for each gold coin picked up. Gold coins will stay on the field for 7s. The user can pick up an opposing Meowth's gold coins as if they were their own.
Scratches at opposing Pokémon becoming a boosted attack with every third attack dealing increased damage and dropping a gold coin.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
The user scratches a designated Pokémon with its sharp claws, dealing damage.

The user hurls a gold coin at the designated Pokémon, dealing damage, slowing down the target by 30% for 1.5s, and dropping a gold coin. 2 uses can be kept in reserve, picking up a gold coin reduces the cooldown of a use by 4s.
Increases the damage dealt by this move.

The user applies a coin mark on opposing Pokémon they hit, the coin mark has up to 5 stacks and lasts for 5s. The user swipes twice with its sharp claws at the designated Pokémon, dealing damage, and granting the user a shield for 5s, and an additional shield per hit (up to 5x) for 5s. The number of swipes can be increased up to 5 if the coin mark is at 3 stacks or higher. Subsequent swipes deal half of the damage of the first hit. This attack will stun opposing Pokémon that have 1/2/3+ coin mark stacks for 0.3/0.5/0.8s respectively. If the maximum number of swipes hit, the cooldowns for Feint, Feint Attack, and Assurance are reduced by 7.5% of the max cooldown per hit, the 5th hit will fully reset the cooldown. If the coin mark is filled up, this move will consume and reset the mark.
Increases the damage dealt by this move.
The user dashes at the designated Pokémon, dealing damage to opponents hit.

The user pounces at the designated Pokémon and scratches them with their claws, dealing damage and stunning the target for 0.6s. When this move hits the user is granted a shield for 3s and can quickly move in a chosen direction. The user's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. If the coin mark is filled up, this move will consume and reset the mark (although this move does not benefit from the coin mark in any fashion).
Improves the strength of the shield.

The user applies a coin mark on opposing Pokémon they hit, the coin mark has up to 5 stacks and lasts for 5s. The user charges in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit and restoring the user's HP, furthermore the move will restore additional HP if the targets have a coin mark. The more stacks the coin mark has the more potent the heal. When this move is used on a Pokémon with a coin mark that has 5 stacks, the damage is doubled. If the coin mark is filled up, this move will consume and reset the mark.

The user becomes unstoppable and unleashes a barrage of gold coins toward the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage in a small area up to 10 times. If another Pokémon on the opposing team stands in the way, they will be hit instead. During the attack, up to 4 coins will periodically drop near Pokémon hit by this move. This move can be cancelled early. Meowth can move while using this move, but is slowed by 110%.
Buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
